 Aaron Sack – Branded Middle Market Investing at Morgan Stanley (Capital Allocators, EP.311) Apr 27, 2023

 My guest on today’s sponsored
insight is Aaron Sack, the head of Morgan Stanley Capital Partners,
Morgan Stanley Investment Management’s middle market private equity
business.

Our conversation covers Aaron’s path to Morgan Stanly sixteen years
ago, the strengths and weaknesses of investing under the umbrella
of the bank, and his team’s investment principles and approach
across sourcing, due diligence, deal making, and operational
improvements. We close discussing the current market dynamics,
competitive positioning, and Aaron’s favorite investment
example.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
